AddSourceResult.title: AddSourceResult
AddSourceResult.description: The upload was staged and a ``source.add`` job is in the queue.

AgentSetup.title: AgentSetup
AgentSetup.description: What an agent needs: the MCP endpoint, the skill, and a clone of each Brain.

ApiTokenView.title: ApiTokenView
ApiTokenView.description: An API token without its secret. ``prefix`` identifies it in the UI.

AuthState.title: AuthState
AuthState.description:
Whether the web UI needs a login, and whether this request has one.

``authenticated`` is True when no login is needed, or when the request has a
valid session cookie or API token.

BrainCreate.title: BrainCreate
BrainCreate.description:
A new Brain: in a new private repository, or in an existing one.

Give exactly one of ``new_repo_name`` (a repository that the connected user
gets) and ``existing_repo`` (``owner/name``). An existing public repository
needs ``confirm_public=True``.

BrainView.title: BrainView
BrainView.description: A Brain. ``slug`` names its default local clone directory for agents.

CreatedApiToken.title: CreatedApiToken
CreatedApiToken.description: A new API token. ``secret`` is shown once and never stored.

DeviceFlowPoll.title: DeviceFlowPoll
DeviceFlowPoll.description:
The result of one device flow poll.

``pending`` and ``slow_down``: poll again after ``interval`` seconds.
``denied`` and ``expired``: start again. ``connected``: ``account`` is set.

DeviceFlowStart.title: DeviceFlowStart
DeviceFlowStart.description:
Show ``user_code`` and ``verification_uri`` to the user, then poll every ``interval`` s.

The device code stays on the server, encrypted; the client never sees it.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
The body of every error response of ``/api`` and ``/mcp``.

``code`` is stable and meant for clients; ``message`` is for people. The other
fields are set only for the codes that need them:

- ``duplicate_source`` (409): ``existing_source``, or ``pending_job`` when the
  same file is still being added.
- ``upload_too_large`` (413): ``max_bytes``.
- ``quota_exceeded`` (409): ``used_bytes``, ``upload_bytes``, ``quota_bytes``.
  Send the upload again with ``confirm_over_quota=true``.
- ``public_repo`` (409): ``repo_full_name``. Send again with ``confirm_public``.
- ``auth`` (401 or 502) and ``upstream`` (502 or 503): ``service``, and
  ``retry_at`` when a rate limit ends.
- ``invalid_request`` (422): ``issues``.

FolderNode.title: FolderNode
FolderNode.description:
A Folder and its subfolders. The root node has ``name`` and ``path`` ``""``.

``source_count`` counts the Sources directly in the Folder,
``total_source_count`` also those in its subfolders.

GitHubAccountView.title: GitHubAccountView
GitHubAccountView.description: The connected GitHub account, without its token.

GitHubPatInput.title: GitHubPatInput
GitHubPatInput.description: A GitHub personal access token that the user pasted. Whitespace around it is removed.

HealthStatus.title: HealthStatus
HealthStatus.description: ``ok`` is True when the database answers. The worker can be offline.

IngestEstimate.title: IngestEstimate
IngestEstimate.description: Parts remaining and estimated input plus output tokens for their Ingest.

InstallUrl.title: InstallUrl
InstallUrl.description: The GitHub page where the user installs the GitHub App on repositories.

JobKind.title: JobKind
JobKind.description: What a job does. One worker handler exists per kind.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Job state. Flow: queued -> running -> succeeded | failed | cancelled.

LfsUsageView.title: LfsUsageView
LfsUsageView.description:
Git LFS storage that the Brain's repository and its owner use, in bytes.

GitHub counts the quota per repository owner, so ``owner_bytes`` adds up every
Brain of ``owner`` and the uploads in the queue.

PageView.title: PageView
PageView.description:
One Markdown file of a Brain: an OKF page, ``index.md``, or ``log.md``.

``type`` is ``""`` for a file without a ``type`` (``index.md``, ``AGENTS.md``).
``body`` is untrusted Markdown: render it without raw HTML.

ProviderInput.title: ProviderInput
ProviderInput.description: A new Provider. ``api_key`` can be empty for a local server that needs no key.

ProviderKind.title: ProviderKind
ProviderKind.description:
The API that a Provider speaks. The base URL is configurable, so any
OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint works.

ProviderTestResult.title: ProviderTestResult
ProviderTestResult.description: The result of a Provider test: one call that lists the Provider's models.

ProviderUpdate.title: ProviderUpdate
ProviderUpdate.description:
Changes to a Provider. ``None`` keeps a field; an empty ``api_key`` removes the key.

A change of ``kind`` or ``base_url`` needs ``api_key`` too when the Provider
has a stored key: the key goes only to the endpoint that it was entered for.

ProviderView.title: ProviderView
ProviderView.description:
A Provider, with its API key masked.

``api_key_last4`` holds the last four characters of the key, and only when the
key has at least ``MASK_MIN_KEY_LENGTH`` characters, so that a short key is
never shown in full.

RepoView.title: RepoView
RepoView.description: A GitHub repository that can hold a Brain. ``brain_id`` is set if one does.

SearchHitView.title: SearchHitView
SearchHitView.description: A search hit. ``snippet`` is escaped Markdown; render it as Markdown.

SetupStatus.title: SetupStatus
SetupStatus.description: What the onboarding screens need to know.

SourceDetail.title: SourceDetail
SourceDetail.description: A Source and the Wiki Pages that cite it, sorted by path.

SourceIngest.title: SourceIngest
SourceIngest.description: Resume matching progress by default, with an optional per-run token budget.

SourceMove.title: SourceMove
SourceMove.description: The target Folder of a Source move. ``""`` is the root of ``sources/``.

SourceStatus.title: SourceStatus
SourceStatus.description: Where a Source is in the Conversion and Ingest steps.

SourceView.title: SourceView
SourceView.description: A Source. ``slug`` is its id, unique in the Brain.

TaskMode.title: TaskMode
TaskMode.description: Where a task runs: in the worker (local) or through a Provider.

TaskName.title: TaskName
TaskName.description: A task that the user can assign to a local model or to a Provider.

TaskSettingInput.title: TaskSettingInput
TaskSettingInput.description:
Where a task runs.

``local`` runs in the worker (transcription only: Whisper, ``model`` is the
Whisper model or ``None`` for the default). ``provider`` needs ``provider_id``
and ``model``.

TaskSettingView.title: TaskSettingView
TaskSettingView.description: The setting of one task. ``configured`` is False when the task cannot run.

TaskSettingsInput.title: TaskSettingsInput
TaskSettingsInput.description:
The full task settings, as ``PUT /settings/tasks`` replaces them.

``None`` resets a task to its default: no ingest Provider (Sources are
converted but not ingested), and local transcription.

TokenCreate.title: TokenCreate
TokenCreate.description: A new API token. The name says which agent or machine uses it.

ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue
ValidationIssue.description:
One problem in a request that the API could not parse.

``location`` is where the problem is, for example ``["body", "name"]`` or
``["query", "limit"]``. The value that was sent is never repeated.

WorkerStatus.title: WorkerStatus
WorkerStatus.description: Whether the worker process runs. The UI shows a warning when it is offline.
